title: Download a PDF with Chrome

setup.why: No copy of this RFC's PDF is left in Download from an earlier run, so the file can't be there before the agent starts.
Bring Chrome up on example.com in the bench's tab.

instruction: In Chrome, download the PDF at https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc{{rfc}}.pdf so that it is saved on the phone.

checks.why: A finished, non-empty rfc{{rfc}}*.pdf is in Download (Chrome's download folder; a second download gets a " (1)" suffix) and starts with the PDF magic "%PDF". A download still in progress has a hidden .pending- name and doesn't count. Setup deleted every copy, so an agent that does nothing fails.
argv: for f in /sdcard/Download/rfc{{rfc}}*.pdf; do [ -s "$f" ] && head -c 4 "$f" && echo; done; true

teardown.why: Delete every copy of the PDF from Download.

oracle.why: A stand-in: no shell command can make Chrome download, so this writes the file the checks look for (a PDF header and nothing else). It proves the check reads a solved state; it doesn't prove Chrome can download.
